headline: Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Plan and Form Based Code follow-up, Westerly State Training Facility tour, and RI Main Street work.
summary: The meeting covers next steps for the Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Plan and its Form Based Code. It also covers the Westerly State Training Facility tour, data analysis work, URI relations, and RI Main Street work.
items: Public comment on matters not on the agenda, with no action taken
Tour of Westerly State Training Facility: follow-up discussion
Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Plan: follow-up on Council consideration of Form Based Code and next steps
Restarting EDC data analysis work: how to take up statistical analysis work from the former SMART Committee
URI relations: how to work with URI on issues like the new medical school
Improving EDC collaboration with other town boards: general discussion
EDC surveys: updates on data and discussion
RI Main Street: ongoing work by the SK Main Street Cohort since the GrowSmart training program ended
Staff update on recent applications and planning activities, with no action taken
New discussion issues and future agenda items suggested by members
location: Town Hall Council Chambers, 180 High Street, Wakefield, RI

Posted on 10/29/2026 
 
Town of South Kingstown  
Economic Development Commission  
Meeting Agenda   
Wednesday, November 4, 2026 at 6:00 PM   
Town Hall Council Chambers 
180 High Street, Wakefield, RI 
www.southkingstownri.gov  
Michael Gagas, Chair 
Randy Apuzzo, Vice Chair 
Thomas Routliffe

Kirk Brown 
Gerry Schaffert 
Ibrahim Fofanah 
-- vacancy -- 
Unless otherwise noted, the EDC may discuss and/or act upon each item on this agenda.  
A. Call to Order & Roll Call 
B. Approval of Minutes: 
 1. 10/7/2026 Draft Minutes 
C. Correspondence & Public Comment: 
Review of correspondence to/from the EDC since the previous meeting & open forum for public comment on 
matters not related to an agenda item. No action will be taken on any item discussed under this agenda item. 
D. Old Business: 
 1. Tour of Westerly State Training Facility - Follow-Up Discussion 
 2. Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Plan - Follow-up discussion on Council consideration of Form Based Code 
and consideration of next steps. 
 3. Restarting EDC Data Analysis Work - Discussion about how the EDC should take up the statistical analysis 
work delegated to the former SMART Committee. 
 4. URI Relations - General discussion about how the EDC might work with URI on issues like the new medical 
school. 
 5. Improving EDC Collaboration with Other Town Boards - General discussion. 
 6. EDC Surveys - Updates on data and discussion. 
E. New Business: 
 1. RI Main Street - Discussion regarding ongoing work by the SK Main Street Cohort since the conclusion of the 
GrowSmart training program. 
F. Staff Update & Planning Department Activities: 
Informational update by staff on recent applications and other activities of interest to the EDC. No action will be 
taken on any matter discussed under this agenda item. 
G. New Discussion Issues & Future Agenda Items: 
Opportunity for EDC members to suggest topics for discussion on upcoming agendas. 
H. Adjournment:
Posted on 10/29/2026
